text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "miles", "kind": "length", "span": "a 12-mile trail"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "time", "span": "took 1 hour to walk the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "miles", "kind": "length", "span": "the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 2, "unit": "miles", "kind": "length", "span": "the next two miles"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 4, "unit": "miles per hour", "kind": "speed", "span": "average speed to be 4 miles per hour"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "trail left after the first 4 miles"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "q4"], "out": "s2", "note": "remaining distance still to walk after the next two miles"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q5"], "out": "s3", "note": "total hours the whole trail may take at the target average speed"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "q2"], "out": "s4", "note": "hours left after the first hour she already walked"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s4", "q2"], "out": "s5", "note": "hours left for the remaining distance after the second hour she walked"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s2", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "speed she needs over the remaining distance"}], "target": {"kind": "speed", "scope": "the speed in miles per hour she needs for the remaining distance"}, "dismissed": []}
